Overlapping Generations and the Golden Rule

See life in generations: earn while young, spend while old. The young generation and the old never actually meet.

The young generation has plenty and the old generation has little. Their lifetimes never overlap, so they cannot trade directly. 💰 Money builds the bridge between them. The young trade goods for money, and spend that money when old.

For example, a grandfather sold 🍚 rice for money when he was young. Now old, he buys rice from a young farmer with that money. When that farmer grows old, he will buy from the next generation. This is how money links the generations.
